instruction: Look at fixture_complex.step in SolidCAM. Set the four fixture blocks in fixture_complex.step as fixture or avoidance geometry. Create safe toolpaths for the central pocket and outside profile while maintaining at least 4 mm clearance from every fixture whenever Z is below 20 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 12 mm end mill for roughing and T2 is a 6 mm end mill for finishing while respecting fixtures. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-17.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
